must_remember: The globally accepted mean value of the solar constant ($S$) is approximately $1367\text{ W/m}^2$.
The solar constant fluctuates by about $\pm 3.3\%$ throughout the year due to the Earth's elliptical orbit.
The effective surface temperature of the Sun is approximately $5778\text{ K}$ or $\sim 5800\text{ K}$.
Only about $51\%$ of incoming solar radiation reaches the Earth's surface directly or diffusely due to atmospheric absorption, scattering, and reflection.
The average solar flux over the Earth's entire spherical surface is $S/4$, accounting for the spherical geometry.

glossary.meaning: The total radiant energy received per second per unit normal area at the outer boundary of the Earth's atmosphere.
The total energy emitted per second by the Sun across all wavelengths.
An instrument used to measure direct beam solar irradiance.
An instrument used to measure global broadband solar radiation on a flat surface.
Relates the total energy emitted per unit surface area of a blackbody to the fourth power of its absolute temperature ($E = \sigma T^4$).
